newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: One, three and six-month Saudi t-bill rates mixed.
newsitem.headline: One, three and six-month Saudi t-bill rates mixed.

text.p: Yields were mixed at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering of three billion riyals worth of Saudi treasury bills, a banker said on Monday.
The yield on 28-day bills rose to 5.4218 percent from 5.3965 last week, while the rate on 91-day paper dropped to 5.4201 percent from 5.4360.
The rate on 182-day bills was steady at 5.4791 percent.
One-month interbank rates were put at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent, three months were at 5-9/16, 7/16 percent and six months were at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent.
